topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and contextualises the study of the complement system.

topics.label: Complement system foundations and the central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational architecture, naming conventions, and central role of C3 activation in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation and trigger threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three upstream pathways that detect pathogens and converge on a concentrated activation threshold.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of activated complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream effector processes of opsonisation, inflammation, and membrane attack complex lysis that eliminate pathogens.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host cell protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms and host-expressed proteins that prevent complement from destroying healthy host tissues.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the distinct clinical presentations and disease liabilities resulting from deficiencies in specific complement components and regulators.

topics.label: Microbial evasion of complement defences
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how pathogens evolved specialized strategies, illustrated by Staphylococcus aureus, to evade and neutralize complement attacks.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture on complement and previews the upcoming session on the adaptive immune system.
